173	The $\nve$ diagnostic requires a reference baseline unavailable during deployment. We propose a lightweight rule-based detector that monitors the value-to-evaluation ratio $r_t = \bar{V}_t / \max(\bar{E}_t, \varepsilon)$ and fires when four conditions hold simultaneously: magnitude ($r_t \geq 0.49$), positive velocity ($\Delta r_t > 0.1$), acceleration ($\Delta r_t > \Delta r_{t-1}$), and evaluation decline ($\geq 2$ of 3 recent checkpoints declining). ve = 10.2	imes$ at 75K), full collapse (seed~2, $

ve = 0.56	imes$, then catastrophic collapse to eval 67.0 and $
ve = 5.47	imes$ by 135K, partially recovering to eval 193.9 by 175K). The delayed-collapse pattern suggests obs-decoder SGS temporarily suppresses CIVO without eliminating the underlying cause; once the suppression fails, the rebound exceeds typical untreated severity ($5.47	imes$ vs.\ $4.12	imes$ for untreated 008d). On Cheetah Run (2 seeds), obs-decoder SGS provides zero protection ($
ve = 21.9	imes$ and $30.2	imes$; eval $< 39$), indistinguishable from the untreated case. The 1/6 prevention rate across environments (Table~ef{tab:intervention_hierarchy}) is not meaningfully different from full-pathway SGS (0/3), confirming that CIVO operates through redundant gradient channels: blocking any single pathway shifts co-adaptation to the remaining ones.
